name: drw: kernel and a block with a hole
drw: a drawing of it
dimset: baseline type along X
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (m.state.editing?.mode !== 'drwDim') await m.run('drwSmartDim'); await sleep(200); document.querySelector('[data-pm-set="dtype"][data-value="baseline"]').click(); await sleep(200); document.querySelector('[data-pm-set="axis"][data-value="x"]')?.click(); await sleep(200); return m.state.editing.dtype + ' ' + Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-set="dtype"][data-value="baseline"] svg')); })()

name: baseline: the left corner
eval: (() => { const b = window.__viewBox('top'); window.__pt = window.__sheetToClient(b.x + b.w * 0, b.y + b.h * 0); return 'ok'; })()

name: baseline: the hole (its centre)
eval: (() => { const b = window.__viewBox('top'); const s = b.w / 100; window.__pt = window.__sheetToClient(b.x + b.w / 2 + 10 * s, b.y + b.h / 2); return 'ok'; })()

name: baseline: the right corner
eval: (() => { const b = window.__viewBox('top'); window.__pt = window.__sheetToClient(b.x + b.w * 1, b.y + b.h * 0); return 'ok'; })()

name: dimset: one baseline set with 50 100 on the sheet
eval: (() => { const d = window.__mymechanics.active(); const a = d.annotations.filter((x) => x.kind === 'drwDim' && x.dtype === 'baseline'); const g = document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg [data-annotation="' + a.at(-1)?.id + '"]'); const txt = [...(g?.querySelectorAll('text') ?? [])].map((t) => t.textContent); return a.length + ' ' + txt.join(' ') + ' ' + new Set([...(g?.querySelectorAll('text') ?? [])].map((t) => Math.round(Number(t.getAttribute('y')) * 10))).size; })()

name: dimset: Esc ends the set
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); m.state.editing.ordinateId = null; m.state.editing.picks = []; return 'ok'; })()

name: dimset: close the page
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await sleep(200); return String(m.state.editing?.mode ?? 'none'); })()

name: gauge: a sheet with an edge flange
gauge: the base flange page shows the gauge table and bend calculation groups; steel 14 sets the thickness
gauge: the bend allowance method shows its table
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); m.actions.pmSet('bendMethod', 'allowance'); await sleep(400); document.querySelector('#left-panel .pm-mini-table')?.scrollIntoView(); await sleep(200); return String(document.querySelectorAll('#left-panel .pm-mini-table input').length); })()

name: gauge: bend allowance table seeded from K, a cell edited, a row added and deleted; the flat pattern follows the table
gauge: DIN 6935 and a K table by r/t change the flat length; a custom gauge row sets the thickness
normal cut: a hole cut through the bend from above; the Normal cut option (shown for sheet parts) cuts it square to the sheet
flat DXF: File › Export › flat pattern as DXF and DWG: outline, a bend line up, a note
